subject: Following up after Inference Edge — RetailX inference needs
messages:
From: Alyssa Wong <alyssa.wong@retailx.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Nice meeting at Inference Edge — quick intro

Hi Jasmine,

Great meeting you at the Inference Edge panel yesterday — loved your notes on routing and fallback policies. Tom and I chatted after and we think some of what you showed could really help RetailX trim inference cost for our checkout personalization models.

Quick background: our personalization stack serves ~1k qps at peak across three regions; currently using a mix of managed endpoints and a homegrown cache layer. Main pain: unpredictable token cost and stalls when scale bursts occur during promotions. We have an RFP in motion and I wanted to understand whether Redwood can support a pilot (dev -> prod), expected latency at 512 tokens, and what sort of SLAs or dedicated options exist.

Are you available for a short call next week to do a discovery and have one of your infra folks join?

Thanks,
Alyssa Wong
Sr. Product Manager, Personalization
RetailX

--
Attachment: InferenceEdge-BizCard.vcf (contact stub)

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Alyssa Wong <alyssa.wong@retailx.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Nice meeting at Inference Edge — quick intro

Hi Alyssa — great to connect, and thanks for the clear context.

Recap from our quick discovery call earlier today (copied Vivek, our SE, and Laura on next steps):

- Current pain: variable token cost, cold-start latency during promo bursts, and limited telemetry for token-level spend.
- Goal: reduce sustained per-token cost by 20–30% while keeping 95th percentile latency under 120ms for 512-token requests.
- Constraints: must run in us-west region for now; security review will require SOC2/ISO reports and a short dataflow diagram.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep-dive with Vivek (SE) — 45 min to review traffic patterns, model variants, and KV cache opportunities (target: week of Nov 16).
2) Pilot proposal: 6-week dev -> prod pilot on a dedicated pool (small cluster) with telemetry collection and cost/latency dashboard. Draft MPA attached.
3) Procurement intro: loop in your procurement team for a light SOW and timeline expectations.

I've attached a one-page mutual action plan (20261112-retailx-map.pdf) and our InferenceEdge slides for context. Vivek — can you confirm availability for the deeper technical session?

If that timeline sounds good, I'll send a Calendly link for the technical call.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

--
Attachments: 20261112-retailx-map.pdf (mutual action plan), InferenceEdge-Intro-Slides.pdf (slides)

Quick options to keep momentum:
- Option A: 45m deep-dive with Vivek this week (he has a 10–12 PT slot open Thu/Fri).
- Option B: I can send a short punchlist (3 items) that your infra team can answer asynchronously if calendar is tight.

If procurement needs an estimate to justify the pilot, we can provide a ballpark monthly commit for a small dedicated pool (I can share ranges—no PO required yet).

Let me know what works; happy to be flexible.

Best,
Jasmine
